Inputs: image1 actual ORI16-daychick after banding, use ONLY juvenile down density/color and immature grayhorn cere/bill/facefoot features; image2 guideadult identification only. No oldgenerated target. Adult male left mostly white and adultfemale right white with darkbrown spots/bars, yellow eyes, black bills hidden inwhitefeatherbase, no prominent ear tufts, thickwhitefeatherfeetblackclaws. Near equalheight, female modestlyfuller but mass notheightmeasurement. Center graymesoptile nestling, immature broad grayhorn cere with graybill darktip as reference, yellow eyes not exactcalibrated, gray-white short branching down around eyes/head and darker dense graybody, NOT masses of repeated closed yarn loops or long ringlet hair. Soft naturally irregular dense tiny downbarbs. Short developing wing sheaths only, no adultwhitewingpanels/longremiges. Rest low and firmly supported on arctic tundra mound with bothwhitefeatherfeet/heels grounded, no handling/bands/hands/grids/prey/nestconstruction. review: 初版/编辑后完整图均实际查看并与ORI实物照比。幼鸟灰角cere/喙及较淡面绒更接近对应参考，不用成人黑bill羽基套young；初版偏长白斑翼片二编已缩短为小翼芽短鞘，未去光所有发育羽。两足/跟有地面支撑无手/环志复制，adult白雄斑雌/羽足黑爪、近等显示非测量。幼鸟宏观闭合大圈较旧v7减少，但编辑后胸腹细长曲丝/部分闭环仍明显且参考本身也有细分枝弯曲，不可凭'全直'负提示声称真实。未校准细羽密度、羽管长/精确日龄/虹膜/比例。NEEDS_REVISION整体保留，局部barepart与翼阶段改善非科学验收。问题→旧target纹理继承；修改→独立实拍整组重建+翼局部返修；复查→头喙与翼局部有效，微材质未解。下一轮需独立阶段影像比较并量化可见差异，不能无限同类柔化凑修复。
